title: Content in Horizontal - or Sloped - Cylindrical Tanks or Pipes
description: Volume of partly filled horizontal or sloped cylindrical tanks or pipes. Calculate the liquid volume, mass, central angle, chord length, arc length, cross-sectional area, and air volume in partly filled horizontal or sloped cylindrical tanks or pipes.

outputs.label: Liquid Volume
outputs.formula: inputs.tank_length * (Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) * Math.acos((inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) / (inputs.inside_diameter / 2)) - (inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) * Math.sqrt(Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) - Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level, 2)))

outputs.label: Liquid Mass
outputs.formula: inputs.liquid_density * inputs.tank_length * (Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) * Math.acos((inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) / (inputs.inside_diameter / 2)) - (inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) * Math.sqrt(Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) - Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level, 2)))

outputs.label: Liquid Cross-Sectional Area
outputs.formula: Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) * Math.acos((inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) / (inputs.inside_diameter / 2)) - (inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) * Math.sqrt(Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) - Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level, 2))

outputs.label: Air Cross-Sectional Area
outputs.formula: Math.PI * Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) - (Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) * Math.acos((inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) / (inputs.inside_diameter / 2)) - (inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) * Math.sqrt(Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) - Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level, 2)))

outputs.label: Air Volume in Tank
outputs.formula: inputs.tank_length * (Math.PI * Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) - (Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) * Math.acos((inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) / (inputs.inside_diameter / 2)) - (inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level) * Math.sqrt(Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2, 2) - Math.pow(inputs.inside_diameter / 2 - inputs.liquid_level, 2))))
